async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the project details for 'a11y-webring.club' using the provided function
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, 'Byte Blaze / a11y-webring.club')
    # Wait for page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 2: Navigate to the issues page for the project
    # From the accessibility tree, there's a link with text '4' for issues count
    issues_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='4', exact=True)
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 3: Find the issue about linking to an accessibility statement
    # Assuming the issue title contains 'accessibility statement' or similar
    # Use filter to locate the correct issue row
    issue_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('link', name='accessibility statement', exact=False))
    # Click on the issue link to open it
    issue_link = issue_row.get_by_role('link').first
    await issue_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 4: Assign the issue to Rohan
    # Look for an assignee button or dropdown
    assignee_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Assign')
    await assignee_button.click()
    # Wait for dropdown to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Search for Rohan in the assignee dropdown
    search_box = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search users')
    await search_box.fill('Rohan')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    # Select Rohan from the results
    rohan_option = page.get_by_role('option', name='Rohan')
    await rohan_option.click()
    # Save the assignment
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save')
    await save_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
